ma.getStorageInfo(Object object)

Asynchronously obtain information about the current storage.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getStorageInfo: ok
keys Array All keys in the current storage
currentSize Number Size of the occupied space, in KB.
limitSize Number Limited space size, in KB.

Sample Code

    ma.getStorageInfo({
      success (res) {
        console.log(res.keys)
        console.log(res.currentSize)
        console.log(res.limitSize)
      }
    })
